contract_plain_english: In the one-dimensional constant-coefficient acoustic setting, a right-going sound wave with positive sound speed c is modeled by w_t + c w_x = 0. The source makes the acoustic variable concrete: if pressure perturbation p and particle velocity u satisfy p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + (1/rho) p_x = 0, with constant material coefficients and c = sqrt(K/rho), then w^1 = p + rho c u satisfies this right-going equation. The complementary combination w^2 = p - rho c u satisfies w^2_t - c w^2_x = 0 and describes leftward propagation. These are the two scalar modes of the full acoustic system [raw PDF page 24, printed page 2, equations (1.4)–(1.6) and following constructions; raw PDF page 25, printed page 3, opening paragraph].
